body:
# EZAuth

**EZAuth** is a completely rewritten version of my older project, OlcsaAuth - a login system for Minecraft servers.  
It provides a simple, secure, and efficient way to protect your server with authentication.

## ✨ Features
- Secure password-based login & registration  
- Session system with customizable timeout  
- Fast and lightweight, no database required (flat-file storage)  
- Easily add support for any language using config.yml
- Easy configuration  

## 🔧 Commands
- `/register <password>` – Register a new account  
- `/login <password>` – Log in to your account  
- `/changepw <old_passwd> <new_passwd>` – Change your password

✔️ **EZAuth** is built for simplicity, security, and performance - making it the perfect choice for any Minecraft server.
